tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): thread recipe Tools to the spawned worker's --tools flag

Command.Tools was parsed but never referenced -- every worker got a
hardcoded --allowedTools grant regardless of what its recipe declared,
so a recipe like summarize (mcp_servers: []) ran with a full shell.

WorkerSpawner.Run now takes the recipe's Tools and passes them verbatim
to claude's --tools flag, which the CLI documents as "" disabling every
built-in tool. strings.Join(nil, ",") == "", so a recipe with no
declared Tools gets none by construction -- there is no separate
default-grant path to keep in sync with that rule. MCP-server tools are
unaffected: they were already, and remain, gated by mcp_servers alone.

Threaded through daemon.Spawner and daemontest.FakeSpawner so every
implementation and test double stays in sync; harness_test.go's
end-to-end fixture now asserts a declared Tools value survives the real
pipeline into the spawned worker, not just WorkerSpawner.Run in
isolation.

Escalation note for the leader: internal/daemontest/daemontest_test.go
is outside this mission's write set but calls FakeSpawner.Run
positionally -- the interface change made it fail to compile. Updated
its two call sites mechanically (added the new tools argument, no
behavior change) since there was no way to land this fix otherwise.

Part of beadle-ivtd.
EOF
)"
